fusions.name: Rooftop Stoop
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Feathers Everywhere
fusions.desc: Looses 3 plucked quills at once, spread apart, out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. Each has 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Fence Hop
fusions.desc: Carries you 4 tiles forward in one hop. Your movement speed rises 20% for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Thieving Accomplice
fusions.desc: Calls a magpie familiar that fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 4 health to you.
